decisionRule: ACCEPT only if there are zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX findings. One SHOULD-FIX survived refutation, therefore REJECT.
discipline: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. The subject was tested against all thirty recorded inputs, frozen platform-tcb-leftover-join.v7, frozen platform-tcb-leftover-join.v6, frozen G22 occupancy v2, both split v7 verdicts, live D-267 and file-08 state, the D-056/D-086/D-125/D-145/D-185/D-219/D-267 authority chain, the complete v7-to-v8 semantic delta, both historical finding dispositions, the exact eight-obligation partition, the two protected leftover-design obligations, every current-versus-historical qualifier, and a full stale-version scan of all subject strings. The current Claude review of this v8 subject was not opened, read, or used.
summary: REJECT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 1 SHOULD-FIX. V8 correctly lands CLAUDE-PTLJ-V7-SF1 by restoring CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1's landing site to leftover-join.v5; accurately records v7 as a split, unrecorded CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; keeps v6 current at draft time and historical only after this successor is recorded; preserves occupancy v2, required-now 28, and the exact two-member leftoverDesign set; and crosses no application, fixture, table, qualification, occupancy, or implementation boundary. But basedOn.predecessorV6.role was copied byte-for-byte from v7 and still says 'This v7 remasures ...' inside the v8 subject. That stale deictic self-label repeats the exact successor-version custody defect class previously rejected in this lineage and must be repaired before acceptance.

findings.title: V8 retains v7's deictic self-label in a predecessor role
findings.charge: The v8 subject's basedOn.predecessorV6.role still says 'This v7 remasures occupancy v1 stale after occupancy v2 (D-219).' That role is byte-identical to v7, where 'This v7' correctly named the speaker. Once republished as v8, the deictic 'This' names the wrong subject version. The same v8 document correctly says 'This v8' in predecessorV7.role and findingDisposition, so it now has conflicting self-labels.
evidence: Top-level identity is artifact platform-tcb-leftover-join.v8 with integer version 8.
The exact predecessorV6.role string is byte-identical between frozen v7 and v8; the v7-to-v8 diff leaves it untouched.
A complete subject string scan finds exactly one 'This v7' occurrence, at basedOn.predecessorV6.role. It finds the current 'This v8' form elsewhere, including basedOn.predecessorV7.role.

The sentence immediately ends with 'Not this artifact's version number', reinforcing that these roles distinguish the current artifact from predecessors; a deictic 'This v7' therefore cannot be treated as a harmless path citation.

This is the same stale-successor self-version defect class as CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1: copied predecessor-role prose becomes false when the successor identity advances. V5's durable repair replaced the earlier version-specific wording with the generic 'Not this artifact's version number' form.
findings.historicalReadingConsidered: The underlying historical proposition is true: v7 remasured v6 after occupancy v2. That does not cure the deictic wording. If historical provenance is intended, the role must name the historical subject explicitly, for example 'leftover-join.v7 remasured occupancy v1 as stale after occupancy v2 (D-219)', instead of calling it 'This v7' from inside v8.
findings.whyShouldFix: The defect is in lineage-custody prose used to distinguish successor identity, and this lineage has already graded the same stale self-version class SHOULD-FIX. Leaving it creates two speaker versions in one artifact and invites the same copy-forward failure on the next successor.
findings.whyNotMustFix: No digest, obligation bit, current-standing claim, authority boundary, or remainder measurement is corrupted. The sentence's historical substance is correct; only its current-subject identity wording is stale.
findings.repair: In a frozen successor, replace the deictic sentence with explicit historical wording such as 'leftover-join.v7 remasured occupancy v1 as stale after occupancy v2 (D-219).' Alternatively use current-subject wording that truthfully describes v8. Do not edit this frozen v8 subject in place.
